verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዕረግ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ወናዳብ ፡ ወአብዩድ ፡ ወመላህቅተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ፸ዘእስራኤል
                  ፡ ወይስግዱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምርሑቅ ።
verses.translation: And to Moses he said, Go up to the Lord, thou and Aaron and Nadab and Abiud, and seventy of the elders of Israel: and they shall worship the Lord from a distance.

translations.lxx: And to Moses he said, Go up to the Lord, thou and Aaron and Nadab and Abiud, and seventy of the elders of Israel: and they shall worship the Lord from a distance.
translations.kjv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Dumnezeu iarăşi către Moise: "Suie-te la Domnul, tu şi Aaron, Nadab, Abiud şi şaptezeci dintre bătrânii lui Israel şi vă închinaţi Domnului de departe.
translations.grk: Καὶ Μωυσῇ εἶπεν, ἀνάβηθι πρὸς τὸν Κύριον σὺ καὶ Ἀαρὼν, καὶ Ναδὰβ, καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ, καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Ἰσραήλ· καὶ προσκυνήσουσι μακρόθεν τῷ Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወይቅረብ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ይቅረብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወእሙንቱ ፡ ኢይቅረቡ ፡ ወሕዝብሂ ፡ ኢይዕረጉ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Moses alone shall draw nigh to God; and they shall not draw nigh, and the people shall not come up with them.

translations.lxx: And Moses alone shall draw nigh to God; and they shall not draw nigh, and the people shall not come up with them.
translations.kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
translations.ron: Numai Moise singur să se apropie de Domnul, iar ceilalţi să nu se apropie; poporul de asemenea să nu se suie cu el!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγγιεῖ Μωσῆς μόνος πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἐγγιοῦσιν, ὁ δὲ λαὸς οὐ συναναβήσεται μετʼ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወቦአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአይድዐ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጽድቆ ፡ ወአውሥኡ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ በ፩ቃል ፡
                  ወይቤሉ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘነበበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ንገብር ፡ ወንሰምዕ ።
verses.translation: And Moses went in and related to the people all the words of God and the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, saying, All the words which the Lord has spoken, we will do and be obedient.

translations.lxx: And Moses went in and related to the people all the words of God and the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, saying, All the words which the Lord has spoken, we will do and be obedient.
translations.kjv: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
translations.ron: A venit deci Moise şi a spus poporului toate cuvintele Domnului şi legile. Atunci a răspuns tot poporul într-un glas şi a zis: "Toate cuvintele pe care le-a grăit Domnul le vom face şi le vom asculta!"
translations.grk: Εἰσῆλθε δὲ Μωυσῆς, καὶ διηγήσατο τῷ λαῷ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα· ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς φωνῇ μιᾷ, λέγοντες, πάντας τοὺς λόγους, οὓς ἐλάλησε Κύριος, ποιήσομεν, καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα.

verses.geez:
ወጸሐፈ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወገይሶ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ሐነጸ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ጠቃ ፡ ደብር ፡
                  ወ፲ወ፪እብን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፲ወ፪ሕዝብ ፡ ዘእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the mountain, and set up twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.

translations.lxx: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the mountain, and set up twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translations.kjv: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
translations.ron: Iar Moise a scris toate cuvintele Domnului. Şi el, sculându-se dis-de-dimineaţă, a zidit jertfelnic sub munte şi a pus doisprezece stâlpi, după cele douăsprezece seminţii ale lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔγραψε Μωυσῆς πάντα τὰ ῥήματα Κυρίου· ὀρθρίσας δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ πρωῒ ᾠκοδόμησε θυσιαστήριον ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος, καὶ δώδεκα λίθους εἰς τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወፈነወ ፡ ወራዙቶሙ ፡ ለውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአዕረጉ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ወሦዑ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አልህምተ ።
verses.translation: And he sent forth the young men of the children of Israel, and they offered whole burnt-offerings, and they sacrificed young calves as a peace-offering to God.

translations.lxx: And he sent forth the young men of the children of Israel, and they offered whole burnt-offerings, and they sacrificed young calves as a peace-offering to God.
translations.kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
translations.ron: A trimis apoi tineri dintre fiii lui Israel, de au adus aceştia arderi de tot şi au jertfit vitei, ca jertfă de izbăvire Domnului Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξαπέστειλε τοὺς νεανίσκους τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἀνήνεγκαν ὁλοκαυτώματα· καὶ ἔθυσαν θυσίαν σωτηρίου τῷ Θεῷ μοσχάρια.

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ወከዐወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃልድ ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ከዐወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: And Moses took half the blood and poured it into bowls, and half the blood he poured out upon the altar.

translations.lxx: And Moses took half the blood and poured it into bowls, and half the blood he poured out upon the altar.
translations.kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
translations.ron: Atunci Moise, luând jumătate din sânge, l-a turnat într-un vas, iar cu cealaltă jumătate de sânge a stropit jertfelnicul.
translations.grk: Λαβὼν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ αἵματος, ἐνέχεεν εἰς κρατῆρας, τὸ δὲ ἥμισυ τοῦ αἵματος προσέχεε πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ወአንበበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዝነ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘነበበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ንገብር ፡ ወንሰምዕ ።
verses.translation: And he took the book of the covenant and read it in the ears of the people, and they said, All things whatsoever the Lord has spoken we will do and hearken therein.

translations.lxx: And he took the book of the covenant and read it in the ears of the people, and they said, All things whatsoever the Lord has spoken we will do and hearken therein.
translations.kjv: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
translations.ron: După aceea, luând cartea legământului, a citit în auzul poporului; iar ei au zis: "Toate câte a grăit Domnul le vom face şi le vom asculta!"
translations.grk: Καὶ λαβὼν τὸ βιβλίον τῆς διαθήκης, ἀνέγνω εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ· καὶ εἶπαν, πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησε Κύριος, ποιήσομεν καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ደመ ፡ ወነዝኀ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ደመ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘሐገገ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንተ
                  ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዝቃል ።
verses.translation: And Moses took the blood and sprinkled it upon the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you concerning all these words.

translations.lxx: And Moses took the blood and sprinkled it upon the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you concerning all these words.
translations.kjv: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
translations.ron: După aceea, luând Moise sângele, a stropit poporul, zicând: "Acesta este sângele legământului, pe care l-a încheiat Domnul cu voi, după toate cuvintele acestea".
translations.grk: Λαβὼν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ αἷμα, κατεσκέδασε τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης, ἧς διέθετο Κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων τῶν λόγων τούτων.

verses.geez: ወዐርጉ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ወናዳብ ፡ ወአብዩድ ፡ ወ፸ሊቃነ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And Moses went up, and Aaron, and Nadab and Abiud, and seventy of the elders of Israel.

translations.lxx: And Moses went up, and Aaron, and Nadab and Abiud, and seventy of the elders of Israel.
translations.kjv: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
translations.ron: Apoi s-a suit Moise şi Aaron, Nadab, Abiud şi şaptezeci dintre bătrânii lui Israel
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν, καὶ Ναδὰβ, καὶ Ἀβιοῦδ, καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα τῆς γερουσίας Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ መካነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘእስራኤል ፡ ወዘታሕተ ፡ እግሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ግብረተ ፡ ግንፋል ፡
                  ዘስንፒር ፡ ወከመ ፡ ርእየተ ፡ ጽንዐ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ኀወጸት ።
verses.translation: And they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and under his feet was as it were a work of sapphire slabs, and as it were the appearance of the firmament of heaven in its purity.

translations.lxx: And they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and under his feet was as it were a work of sapphire slabs, and as it were the appearance of the firmament of heaven in its purity.
translations.kjv: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
translations.ron: Şi au văzut locul unde stătea Dumnezeul lui Israel; sub picioarele Lui era ceva, ce semăna cu un lucru de safir, curat şi limpede ca seninul cerului.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδον τὸν τόπον οὗ εἱστήκει ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ· καὶ τὰ ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, ὡσεὶ ἔργον πλίνθου σαπφείρου, καὶ ὥσπερ εἶδος στερεώματος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῇ καθαριότητι.

verses.geez: ወኅሩያኒሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ዘይመስሎሙ ፡ አስተርአዩ ፡ በመካን ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወበልዑ ፡ ወሰትዩ ።
verses.translation: And of the chosen ones of Israel there was not even one missing, and they appeared in the place of God, and did eat and drink.

translations.lxx: And of the chosen ones of Israel there was not even one missing, and they appeared in the place of God, and did eat and drink.
translations.kjv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
translations.ron: Dar El n-a întins mâna Sa împotriva aleşilor lui Israel, iar ei au văzut pe Dumnezeu, apoi au mâncat şi au băut.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῶν ἐπιλέκτων τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ οὐ διεφώνησεν οὐδὲ εἷς· καὶ ὤφθησαν ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዕረግ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወሀሉ ፡ ህየ ፡ ወአሀብከ ፡ ሰሊዳተ ፡ ዘእብን ፡
                  ዘሕግ ፡ ወትእዛዝ ፡ ዘጸሐፍኩ ፡ ትሕግግ ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Come up to me into the mountain, and be there; and I will give thee the tables of stone, the law and the commandments, which I have written to give them laws.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Come up to me into the mountain, and be there; and I will give thee the tables of stone, the law and the commandments, which I have written to give them laws.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul către Moise: "Suie-te la Mine în munte şi fii acolo, că am să-ţi dau table de piatră, legea şi poruncile, pe care le-am scris Eu pentru învăţătura lor!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, ἀνάβηθι πρὸς με εἰς τὸ ὄρος, καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ· καὶ δώσω σοι τὰ πυξία τὰ λίθινα, τὸν νόμον καὶ τὰς ἐντολας, ἃς ἔγραψα νομοθετῆσαι αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወተንሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወኢየሱስ ፡ ወዐርጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses rose up and Joshua his attendant, and they went up into the mount of God.

translations.lxx: And Moses rose up and Joshua his attendant, and they went up into the mount of God.
translations.kjv: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
translations.ron: Atunci, sculându-se Moise împreună cu Iosua, slujitorul său, s-a suit în muntele Domnului;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναστὰς Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ παρεστηκὼς αὐτῷ, ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ Θεοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሊቃን ፡ ኢትትዋከቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ንሠወጥ ፡ ኀቤክሙ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወሆር ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ ለእመቦ
                  ፡ ዘመጽአ ፡ ፍትሕ ፡ ይሑር ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And to the elders they said, Rest there till we return to you; and behold, Aaron and Or are with you: if any man have a cause to be tried, let them go to them.

translations.lxx: And to the elders they said, Rest there till we return to you; and behold, Aaron and Or are with you: if any man have a cause to be tried, let them go to them.
translations.kjv: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
translations.ron: Iar bătrânilor le-a zis: "Rămâneţi aici până ne vom întoarce la voi. Iată Aaron şi Or sunt cu voi; de va avea cineva pricină, să vină la ei".
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις εἶπαν, ἡσυχάζετε αὐτοῦ, ἕως ἀναστρέψωμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς· καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἀαρὼν καὶ Ὢρ μεθʼ ὑμῶν· ἐάν τινι συμβῇ κρίσις, προσπορευέσθωσαν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወዐርገ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወሰወረ ፡ ደብሮ ፡ ደመና ።
verses.translation: And Moses and Joshua went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

translations.lxx: And Moses and Joshua went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
translations.kjv: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
translations.ron: S-a suit deci Moise şi Iosua în munte şi un nor a acoperit muntele.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ὄρος· καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ἡ νεφέλη τὸ ὄρος.

verses.geez:
ወወረደ ፡ ሠርሑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ዘሲና ፡ ወሰወሮ ፡ ደመና ፡ ሰዱሰ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ወጸውዖ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ እማእከለ ፡ ደመና ።
verses.translation: And the glory of God came down upon the mount Sina, and the cloud covered it six days; and the Lord called Moses on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud.

translations.lxx: And the glory of God came down upon the mount Sina, and the cloud covered it six days; and the Lord called Moses on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud.
translations.kjv: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
translations.ron: Slava Domnului s-a pogorât pe Muntele Sinai şi l-a acoperit norul şase zile, iar în ziua a şaptea a strigat Domnul pe Moise din mijlocul norului.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβη ἡ δόξα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινὰ, καὶ ἐκάλυψεν αὐτὸ ἡ νεφέλη ἓξ ἡμέρας· καὶ ἐκάλεσε Κύριος τὸν Μωυσῆν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐκ μέσου τῆς νεφέλης.

verses.geez:
ወአርአያ ፡ ሥራሑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ንደተ ፡ እሳት ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያንበለብል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማሁ ፡ ለደብር ፡
                  በቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ለውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the appearance of the glory of the Lord was as burning fire on the top of the mountain, before the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And the appearance of the glory of the Lord was as burning fire on the top of the mountain, before the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Chipul slavei Domnului de pe vârful muntelui era în ochii fiilor lui Israel, ca un foc mistuitor.
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ εἶδος τῆς δόξης Κυρίου, ὡσεὶ πῦρ φλέγον ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους, ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወቦአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ደመና ፡ ወዐርገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ፴ዕለተ ፡ ወ፴ሌሊተ ።
verses.translation: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and went up to the mountain, and was there in the mountain forty days and forty nights.

translations.lxx: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and went up to the mountain, and was there in the mountain forty days and forty nights.
translations.kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
translations.ron: Şi s-a suit Moise pe munte şi a intrat în mijlocul norului; şi a stat Moise pe munte patruzeci de zile şi patruzeci de nopţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθε Μωυσῆς εἰς τὸ μέσον τῆς νεφέλης, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος· καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας.
